items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I played with Joe a long time, around here.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Who else is in that band? Mike DeLay? Mike DeLay. Uh...
Joe Derensburg? Yeah. He is in that band too. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. I played with Joe a long time, around here.
